what: One place on either side of the border at Baarle, where Belgian enclaves (Baarle-Hertog) lie inside Noord-Brabant (Baarle-Nassau): the town halls of both, about 450 m apart. Each must be labelled as the place finder labels an OpenStreetMap row.
outline_note: Synthetic and simplified, not Kadaster data: Noord-Brabant as a rectangle with one hole for a Belgian enclave. The real outlines (Kadaster BRK Bestuurlijke Gebieden, provinciegebied) have 22 such holes, some with Dutch ground in them again.
points_from: OpenStreetMap (ODbL), as in the trial build of 26 November 2026
